name: Bun bo Hue
summary: Bun bo Hue is a spicy beef and pork noodle soup from Hue, stained with annatto and finished with lemongrass and shrimp paste. It is heavier and hotter than pho.
origin: Hue. The city version is the one to judge the dish by.
howToEat: Ask for it less spicy if you need to. The chili spoon is often separate.
Herbs and lime come on the side. Add shredded banana blossom if it arrives.
Eat it at a shop that serves little else.
where: Eat it in Hue if the bowl is why you came. In Da Nang, Bà Hương at 229 Đống Đa serves it. The Hue city bowl is the one to judge.
priceBand: A shop bowl is an everyday price.
seoTitle: Bun bo Hue — the spicy noodle soup
seoDescription: How bun bo Hue differs from pho, and how to eat a bowl in Hue.
